items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We had a vocalist named Bill Jones.

ctx.x: But anyway, we all used to hang around through there. And so, Howard formed this band to go into the Finale Club on First and San Pedro. The personnel was Earl (?) on piano, Bob Kesterson, bass, and Roy Porter, drums. And we had Gene Montgomery on tenor, Sonny Criss on alto, Charlie Parker on the other alto, and I'm on the tenor. That was the saxophone section. It was too bad this band wasn't recorded. It was during the recording ban. Do you remember the recording ban, when they struck, the American Federation of…
We had a vocalist named Bill Jones. Now, do you remember Bill Jones?
